question: Do the four certified order-42 graphs obtained by deleting a shared-core vertex from each of the 22 exact E=2 near misses add isomorphism classes beyond the supplied 328-line order-42 catalog?
mathematical_basis: When two same-colour forbidden five-sets intersect in a four-set C, deleting any vertex of C destroys both; if they are the only forbidden five-sets, each deletion is a Ramsey(5,5;42) graph.
expected_checks: Each source has exactly two homogeneous five-sets of one colour intersecting in exactly four vertices.
All 88 core deletions have order 42 and pass direct all-five-subset enumeration.
All 88 core deletions independently pass recursive bitset clique searches in the graph and complement.
nauty labelg canonicalizes both each graph and its complement before catalog comparison.

outcome_policy.novel_classes: Retain one canonical graph per new complement-normalized class as new constructive seeds; novelty is only relative to the supplied catalog.
outcome_policy.no_novel_classes: Record closure of this finite 22-candidate transformation only; do not infer completeness of the order-42 catalog.
outcome_policy.verification_failure: Stop and make no transformation or novelty claim.
